other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage via feature engineering before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: Engineered features that depend on dataset distributions (like target encoding, groupby aggregations, or frequency encoding) are computed on the combined train and test dataset before splitting. This leaks the distribution of the test set into the training features.

summary: The agent builds a well-structured pipeline with robust data cleaning, advanced feature engineering, and a properly optimized ensemble. However, a critical data leakage flaw exists because dataset-level statistics (groupby aggregations and frequency encodings) are computed on the combined train and test sets prior to splitting.
